review_candidates.description: Director of IT will oversee the deployment, security, and support of hardware, field-connectivity solutions, and specialized building software. They will bridge the gap between field crews and corporate operations to ensure projects run smoothly using modern technology like BIM (Building Information Modeling), Procore, MS Office 365, and other technologies. Key Responsibilities Systems Management: Maintain and support construction management software (such as estimating, scheduling, and ERP tools) for office and field staff. Field Technology & Infrastructure: Set up reliable temporary internet, mobile device management (MDM), and hardware for remote or active construction sites. Vendor & SaaS Management: Negotiate contracts and manage relationships with external software-as-a-service (SaaS) providers and hardware vendors. Cybersecurity & Data Protection: Safeguard company networks, blueprints, financial data, and client communications against cyber threats. User Support & Training: Lead an IT helpdesk to troubleshoot technical issues for project managers, engineers, and field laborers. Industry Familiarity: Understanding of construction workflows, project lifecycles, and software tools like Procore, Bluebeam, or AutoCAD. Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical construction professionals.

review_candidates.title: Vice President, Business Technology
review_candidates.description: About Us RJC Engineers is a well-established, employee-owned engineering firm with a broad geographic footprint and deep roots across Canada and the United States. We are leaders in structural engineering, building science, structural restoration, structural glass engineering, parking facility design, and building energy modelling. What sets us apart? Our commitment to clients, cutting-edge technology, collaborative culture, and the passion of our people. We’re driven by a purpose: to positively impact our communities and invest in our team’s growth and success. At RJC, you’ll join an inclusive, fast-paced team tackling exciting and complex projects. You’ll work alongside industry-leading experts, explore emerging technologies, and be supported in your continuous professional development. Being an RJC Professional We build our team around five key attributes: Creative Mindset – You bring fresh ideas, challenge assumptions, and turn obstacles into opportunities. Proactive Approach – You take initiative, anticipate challenges, and seek ways to create a positive impact. Supportive Teamwork – You foster a culture of inclusivity, respect, and collaboration, helping others succeed. Trusted Advisor – You act with integrity, expertise, and honesty, earning the confidence of clients and colleagues. Lead with Purpose – You empower, support, and guide others, driving meaningful results. Location: Vancouver, Toronto, Edmonton or Calgary Compensation: $190,000 – $220,000 The Opportunity The Vice President, Business Technology is a strategic senior leadership role responsible for enabling organizational capability through technology, information, enterprise systems, and digital services. Reporting to an Executive Principal, and working closely with operational and function leaders across the organization, this role ensures RJC has the systems, infrastructure, information, governance, and technology capabilities necessary to support operational excellence, informed decision-making, effective collaboration, and sustainable growth. The leader in this role will serve as both a strategic advisor and operational leader, helping ensure that technology investments deliver meaningful business outcomes while supporting RJC's long-term vision. A critical component of this role will be the ongoing stewardship, optimization, governance, and evolution of RJC's enterprise business systems, including the firm's ERP platform. The successful candidate will help ensure these investments continue to strengthen business processes, improve data quality, enable organizational effectiveness, and support future growth. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Develop and execute a Business Technology strategy aligned with RJC’s purpose, vision, and long-term priorities, ensuring technology investments strengthen operations, employee experience, client value, and measurable business outcomes. Provide strategic leadership that builds a high-performing, innovative, service-focused team and strengthens connection across the organization. Collaborate with business and functional leaders to champion organizational change and the responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including analytics, automation, and AI, that deliver positive business outcomes. Governance, Risk, and Resilience Establish and maintain a business technology governance framework, including policies, standards, and data governance practices, to ensure the integrity, security, accessibility, and regulatory compliance of organizational information and business systems. Set direction for cybersecurity and infrastructure risk management, ensuring gaps are identified, prioritized, and addressed. Direct business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience planning to ensure uninterrupted operations and effective risk mitigation. Business Partnership & Enterprise Systems Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, partnering across the organization to understand needs and translate them into scalable technology solutions that enhance productivity and support business objectives. Provide executive-level leadership for RJC’s ERP platform and enterprise business systems, including governance, optimization, integration, reporting, and future evolution, ensuring systems, data, and knowledge management support effective processes, decision-making, collaboration, and growth. Operational Oversight, Team & Stewardship Oversee the delivery and performance of technology infrastructure, applications, and services, ensuring reliability, scalability, and an exceptional user experience. Establish and monitor key performance indicators and service metrics to measure operational effectiveness, project outcomes, and team performance. Oversee workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, vendor and contract management, and financial stewardship to optimize the value of technology investments across the organization. Professional Qualifications & Experience 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in business technology, enterprise systems, business operations, or related fields, including 6+ years leading enterprise technology functions and organizational change. Proven experience overseeing ERP platforms and enterprise business applications through implementation, stabilization, optimization, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement. Strong ability to align technology investments with business strategy, operational effectiveness, employee experience, client value, and measurable outcomes. Deep understanding of cybersecurity, privacy, risk management, data governance, enterprise architecture, information management, and emerging technology enablement. Exceptional leadership, communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business decisions. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will be considered. Why Join RJC? This is an opportunity to help shape the future of one of Canada's leading employee-owned engineering firms. As Vice President, Business Technology, you will: Play a key role in advancing RJC's Purpose, Promise, Vision, and long-term strategic priorities. Provide leadership for one of the firm's most significant business transformation initiatives through the continued evolution of our ERP platform and enterprise business systems. Help strengthen the technology, information, and knowledge capabilities that enable our people to do their best work. Partner with leaders across the organization to improve collaboration, decision-making, innovation, and organizational effectiveness. Contribute to the long-term success of an employee-owned organization committed to technical excellence, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. What We Offer Competitive compensation and performance-based bonus program. Opportunity to participate in RJC's share ownership program. Comprehensive benefits package, including Health Care Spending Account. Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up Program. RRSP matching program. A collaborative and supportive employee-owned culture. Meaningful opportunities for professional growth and leadership development. Attention Staffing & Recruitment Agencies: RJC Engineers, will not pay fees for recruitment activities related to the hiring of a candidate unless a written service agreement has been established between a duly authorized representative of our Corporate Human Resources department and the recruitment/placement firm. In addition, to qualify for recruitment fees, all candidate resumes must be submitted to RJC Engineers, through our Corporate Human Resources department. Resumes and profiles sent to our managers without the express agreement of our Corporate Human Resources department will not be eligible for a fee

review_candidates.description: Company Description Onspec Engineering & Contracting is a leading EPC firm serving the oil, gas, petrochemical, and renewable energy markets across Egypt and the broader MENA region. With over 20 years of experience and more than 300 executed projects, the company delivers fully integrated consulting, turnkey solutions, and EPC services, including engineering, procurement, construction, project management, equipment supply, training, and software tools. Onspec is recognized for driving digital transformation in the sector, combining strong core competencies with a focus on high-quality service aligned with client objectives. Its 200 team members are motivated by a culture of outstanding execution, strategic innovation, and challenging industry norms. The company’s purpose is to improve clients’ project economics, enhance performance, and reduce emissions, reflecting a deep commitment to excellence in the energy business. Role Description The Senior Talent Management Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for designing and implementing talent management strategies that support organizational growth and performance within a dynamic engineering and EPC environment. Day-to-day activities include developing and overseeing performance management frameworks, succession planning programs, and employee engagement initiatives in alignment with business objectives. The specialist will collaborate with leadership and HR partners to identify critical roles, assess talent, and build development plans, including training and learning interventions. The role also involves analyzing workforce data, recommending improvements to talent processes, supporting change management efforts, and ensuring that talent practices reflect the company’s culture of excellence and innovation. Qualifications Demonstrated expertise in Talent Management and Succession Planning to build robust pipelines for critical roles and future leaders. Strong skills in Performance Management to design, implement, and continuously improve evaluation and feedback systems. Experience in Employee Engagement initiatives to foster a positive work environment, retention, and high performance. Proficiency in Training & Development to create and manage learning programs that support technical and behavioral growth. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) is an advantage. Proven experience in a senior HR or talent management role, preferably within engineering, energy, or project-based industries. Strong analytical, data interpretation, and reporting skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable talent strategies. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation abilities, with a collaborative and inclusive approach. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is highly beneficial. careers@onspec.net

Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. review_candidates.title: IoT Product Manager - Smart Mobility Services - Products and Marketing
review_candidates.description: About Us Join us at Orange Business! We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities. About The Role As part of the IoT Connect Advanced product team, you are responsible for the Business-to-Business (B2B) component of the product offer. In this role, you design, animate and make evolve a product offer that our business customers -primarily in the automotive segment- will use to connect their products (to the internet or to their own servers). An interest in automotive, particularly its software application and infotainment system, is therefore a plus. As part of your daily product marketing activities, you will analyze and keep track of what is happening on the IoT market and constantly evaluate customer needs and requests. The IOT environment is full of complex demands for many reasons: large varieties of devices, diverse market segments, necessity to integrate into the Customer’s ecosystem, different technological priorities…. One of your many missions will be to prioritize projects and advise/coordinate with the sales teams how to take maximum advantage of the product projects that are on the planning, in a context where developments are happening at a very high pace and market expectations and demands are high. In the same team is also the IoT Connect Advanced Product Manager in charge of the IoT Connect Advanced B2B2C offer. Both you and your B2B2C offer counterpart will report to the IoT Connect Advanced Marketing Manager. Your Role And Responsibilities In a complex and fast-evolving IoT ecosystem, the IoT Product Manager defines, launches, and manages IoT connectivity offers. The role bridges customers, sales, marketing, technical teams, and partners. Your main activities as IoT Product Manager for B2B: Analyze the IoT market, its customers, competitor offerings, and ecosystem(s). Define, launch, and make evolve the IoT B2B offer, to stay ahead of the competition. Making it as attractive as possible and differentiating, for a variety of customers (particularly automotive) and in compliance with the legal/regulatory framework (focus on Europe). Define and manage the business plan for the IoT B2B offer, built jointly with the Sales channels, and modeled with the help of the finance department. Assess costs, risks, and profitability. Support the sales teams in qualifying IoT opportunities. Lead offer launches according to the Time-To-Market (TTM) and Scaled Agile (SAFe) methodologies, aligned with the resources of the different stakeholders (Orange-internal departments & external suppliers) involved: Project Manager, Operational Marketing, Communication, Technical and IS Management, Operations, Sales Legal etc… Project managent skills are a plus. Advise sales and customer teams on the product mid-term and long-term strategy, highlighting product priorities, the value proposition and how to optimally bring forward the most convincing arguments as part of the sales pitch / how to respond to demanding customer requirements. About You You have min 8 years experience in marketing offers or products, ideally in the field of IoT or IT Ability to listen and lead, combined with very good communication skills (oral and written) You are recognized for your creativity and able to propose innovative and customer convincing & contract-winning product approaches and suggestions experience in dealing with customer requests (customer-facing role) is a plus Key skills & competences: Listen and act: identify, qualify and formalize current customer needs and usage. Anticipate as much as possible upcoming customer trends & needs and plan accordingly. Have an entrepreneurial spirit, innovate, take initiative Agile and flexible mindset as the marketing plan may be revised due to a changing market need Work together and drive cross-functional teams ; fostering team spirit and transversality Strong synthesis and presentation skills You are ready to operate within a large international organization Fluent in English and French are a must You bring rigor, passion for challenges, and determination. You seek the opportunity to expand your expertise, achieve your goals, and thrive. What We Offer Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world. Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working). Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities. Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange. Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events. Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards. Only Your Skills Matter Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.
